prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: original head-and-shoulders portrait SOURCE CANDIDATE for the project's Dr Watson support character; a standalone square image, with no UI.
Input image 1: the project's own Dr Watson front design, the identity and craftsmanship reference. Recompose this same character as a head-and-shoulders portrait. Preserve his mature broad angular face, heavy curled brown moustache, brown hair and sideburns, stern attentive expression, black rounded bowler with narrow curled brim, brown overcoat with broad lapels, tan patterned waistcoat, white shirt and dark brown tie. Do not substitute a different Watson or an actor likeness.
Scene/backdrop: plain matte charcoal background.
Style/medium: richly crafted painted tabletop miniature / stylized sculptural character illustration matching the supplied project design; crisp sculpted planes, subtle brushwork, tactile wool, felt and leather. Not a photograph or a scan.
Composition/framing: one centered character, head and shoulders, square 1:1 canvas. Face nearly frontal with both eyes open, clearly visible and near the horizontal center. Show the entire bowler crown and both brim tips, ears, hair, chin, neck and both shoulder silhouettes. Generous empty charcoal margins: highest hat point about 17 percent below the top, hat and head silhouette inside the central 60 percent of image width, shoulder silhouette inside the central 82 percent. Include the bust to the upper chest with breathing room below. Keep all headgear, head and face comfortably inside an imaginary centered circle occupying 90 percent of the image width; do not draw the circle.
Lighting/mood: restrained warm soft key and gentle cool fill, enough separation from charcoal to read black felt and both eyes, no theatrical glow.
Color palette: preserve coat brown #5E4532, bowler black #1F1E1E, waistcoat tan #A08262 and any tiny visible gold fastening #C9A24A; natural warm skin.
Constraints: preserve the approved project design identity and costume. One single bust portrait. Hands, revolver, medical bag and plinth stay outside this head-and-shoulders composition. No redesign, no other people, no commercial artwork, no lettering, numerals, labels, logo, watermark, frame, medallion, border, UI, panels or graphic layout. Opaque charcoal background.
